title: Understanding Bootstrap Replicates
text: Bootstrap replicates are used to estimate the sampling distribution of a statistic by resampling with replacement from the original data. Look at how the replicates are structured in the table. Are they organized by rows or columns?

title: Effect of Increasing Bootstrap Replicate Size
text: Increasing the size of each bootstrap replicate means drawing more samples in each replicate. Consider how this affects the variability of the sample mean.

title: Impact on Variance
text: What happens to the variance of the sample mean when you increase the sample size?
